text:
dana: CI just went red on main, image-diff tests failing across macos/linux runners :frowning:
ci-bot: Job #4821 (integration/image-tests) failed — see https://ci.internal/job/4821 — exit code 1
dana: example failure:
```
E   AssertionError: images differ (expected vs actual)
E   Diff saved to /tmp/artifacts/failed_diff_123.png
```
ben: hmm did we just regen the poetry.lock in the deps-constraints PR? I saw a lockfile update in #3412 earlier today
lee: yep, that PR bumped Pillow from 9.5.0 -> 10.0.0 as transitive via requirements-tools
maria: Pillow 10 changed default resampling for thumbnail or removed some deprecated alias? could affect rasterization tests
dana: reproduction locally: docker image (python:3.10), `pip install -r test-requirements.txt` then `pytest tests/image_diff.py::test_avatar_scaling -q` fails for me with Pillow 10
ben: can you paste pip freeze?
dana: `Pillow==10.0.0
numpy==1.26.0
...`
lee: quick triage: try pinning Pillow back to 9.5.0 in the lockfile to confirm. if that fixes, we need a targeted constraint in pyproject or change the test baseline
maria: also run `git bisect` against the lock regen commit — but easier: revert lockfile on the branch and trigger CI?
dana: requesting a bisect: can someone with CI perms trigger a bisect-run? I don't have quota on the infra job runner
eng-ci: @dana I've queued a rerun with `POETRY_LOCK_OVERRIDE=old` which pins to previous lock for a test rerun, job 4823 queued
ci-bot: Job #4823 started (repro with old lock)
dana: thanks. if that passes we have strong evidence lock regen caused it
ben: alternatively, we could make the image-diff test tolerant: update expected PNG generator to use explicit resample=Image.LANCZOS to avoid default change
lee: I like explicitness in tests, but that might mask real regressions in how rendering is done in prod. I'd prefer test change + note in changelog if we accept 10.0.0
maria: for immediate green, pin to 9.5.0 in the constraints merge and open a follow-up to either fix tests or accept Pillow 10 with adjusted baselines
dana: if someone can push a quick revert of the lockfile to the constraints branch it'll speed up things. Who can?
ben: I'll push a revert PR in ~10m and trigger CI. assigning to me
lee: I'll start a local bisect too to confirm exact transitive that pulled in Pillow 10 (maybe via imaging-utils 2.1.0?)
eng-ci: Job #4823 passed ✅ (old lock)
dana: ok that confirms it. thanks @eng-ci :tada:
ben: opened PR #3420 to pin Pillow==9.5.0 in constraints and reverted lockfile changes. CI triggered
ci-bot: Job #4830 started for PR #3420
maria: follow-up task: decide if we upgrade to Pillow 10 — if so, update tests to explicit resample and regenerate golden images under 10.0.0
lee: note: some supported OSes may not have prebuilt wheels for Pillow 10 on older manylinux, so watch for wheel build failures on alpine/musl runners
dana: great catch everyone. I'll add an entry in the postmortem board for dependency-regen risk and suggest a short checklist for lock bumps
ana: (typo) — dana: also add pointer to `poetry lock --no-update` workflow for local verification before committing
ben: CI for PR #3420 passed ✅ — merging to unblock main
ci-bot: Merged PR #3420 into main — main is green
lee: follow-up created: tickets/INF-876 (evaluate upgrading to Pillow 10; regen golden images if accepted)
maria: awesome. small ask: can we add a lint step to detect major-version bumps in lock regenerations? would have flagged this
dana: good idea. I'll add it to infra backlog. Thanks all :raised_hands:
